We solved all 101 authored items blind from promptDe plus options, tiles or audio line (24 MC, 33 fill_blank, 13 sentence_building, 10 error_correction, 15 cloze, 5 R/F, 1 dictation). We enumerated every tile order that follows V2 or verb-final order, and compared each result with answer and accepted[]. We traced the two generated LS2 dictations (sources l03, l06) through src/components/course-v2/content.js dictationItems and src/lib/lesson/check.js, which now folds number words in dictations (foldNumberWords) and grades a case-only miss as TYPO. We checked the lexicon against b2.2/lexicon.json and every lower level's lexicon, and sentence lengths against level-profiles b2.2 (maxWords 30). verdict: The unit's own content is now at exit level. All nine unit-owned r2 findings are fixed. KEY-01 passes because the Auftakt was dropped (the unit-only fallback r2 offered). The level-mate cues now exclude fehlerhaft and accept Gegenvorschlag. The dictations use two short lines without numbers. Every correction item names what to correct.
